summary:
App: MiroTalk P2P, a self-hosted WebRTC video meeting app. Five views saved, all replayed successfully.

1. meeting-grid: the main meeting room "northwind-product-weekly". It shows a grid of attendee tiles (avatars or initials, pin/video/audio/raised-hand indicators, presenter badge) and the bottom control toolbar.
2. room-settings: the in-meeting settings dialog on its Room tab. It has a sectioned sidebar (Room, Recording, Video, Share media, Profile, Shortcuts, Connectivity, Network, Layout, Appearance, Language), the room name and preference toggles.
3. polls-panel: a floating Polls window with two seeded polls. It shows percentage bars, vote counts, voter names and an anonymous flag.
4. chat-window: the chat window. A sidebar lists Room chat, ChatGPT and attendees; the room thread has one sent message, and the composer has its toolbar.
5. active-rooms: the /activeRooms dashboard. It has a search field, stat cards (9 rooms, 33 peers) and a grid of room cards with Join buttons.

How the in-room views are replayed:
- The server won't let two people in a room use the same name. Because my own browser stays in the room as "Dana Okafor", a straight replay got a "Username is already in use" prompt and was sent back to the home page.
- The fix: every in-room view first renames my session to "Dana O." (Settings → Profile → Change). The replay browser can then join as Dana Okafor.
- As a side effect, replayed in-room screens show an extra "Dana O." tile and sometimes a brief "Username is already in use" or "Buttons always visible" toast.
- The meeting-grid and polls views also switch on "Keep controls visible" so the toolbar doesn't auto-hide during replay.

Not captured:
- The ChatGPT chat tab: the local stub replied "Connection error", so I used the Room chat instead.
- The pre-join lobby (/join/<room> without a name), the landing page, the whiteboard and the shared editor, because I ran short of actions. The landing page counts as marketing anyway.
